description: A PHP class providing static functions for managing Drupal project versions and composer scripts, including updating metapackages, setting Drupal version, and ensuring composer version compatibility.

classes.name: Composer
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing Drupal project versions and composer script events.

methods.name: generateMetapackages
methods.description: Generates metapackages when composer.lock is updated.

methods.name: generateComponentPackages
methods.description: Updates component packages when composer.lock is updated.

methods.name: setDrupalVersion
methods.description: Sets the Drupal version and updates related files and stability settings.

methods.name: setTemplateProjectStability
methods.description: Sets the minimum stability for template subprojects based on Drupal version.

methods.name: ensureComposerVersion
methods.description: Checks that the installed Composer version meets the minimum requirement.

methods.name: drupalVersionBranch
methods.description: Returns the branch name associated with the current Drupal version.

methods.name: composerSubprojectPaths
methods.description: Returns a Finder object for subproject composer.json files of a given type.
